sonnetReviewNote: 3 of 5 units in review-group A ('conflicting' verdicts) were FALSE NEGATIVES: pre-1997/2002 ARES VR historical officer entries frequently omit datumNarozeni (birth date) entirely, so the deterministic birth-date-exact matcher cannot confirm even an exact name+date-range match on old paper-era filings. Recommended fix for the next batch: add a name-similarity fallback pass for VR entries with a null birth date before defaulting to 'conflicting' (see handoff.md lessons).
